# pt_gen_sample.txt -- the synthetic sample input of tb/pt_gen.sv
# (BP-149, perf_decisions.md PF-17), one hexadecimal address per line.
# Not taken from a trace. It covers:
#   - 600 consecutive pages from VA 0x40_0000, so more than one leaf
#     table is filled: 512 share the leaf table of VA[56:21] = 2 and 88
#     the next one; every page shares the level-1 table above them
#   - a page needing a new table at each level: a new leaf table
#     (0x80_0000), a new level-1 table (VA bit 30), a new level-2 table
#     (VA bit 39), a new level-3 table (VA bit 48)
#   - both canonical halves under Sv57: the high half's lowest address
#     (bit 56 set, root index 0x100) and its top two pages (root index
#     0x1FF), which share every table
#   - repeated pages, an address inside a page already named, a 0x
#     prefix and upper-case digits
# Distinct pages 607; table pages 24 (root 1, level 3: 4, level 2: 5,
# level 1: 6, level 0: 8).
#

# ---- a new table at each level ------------------------------------------
# a new leaf table, the same level-1 table: VA[56:21] = 4
800000
# a new level-1 table: VA bit 30
40000000
# a new level-2 table: VA bit 39
8000000000
# a new level-3 table: VA bit 48
1000000000000

# ---- the high half --------------------------------------------------------
# bit 56 set, bits 55:0 clear: the lowest canonical high address, root
# index 0x100
ff00000000000000
# the top page and the page below it: root index 0x1FF, every table
# shared
fffffffffffff000
FFFFFFFFFFFFE000

# ---- repeated pages: none adds a page -------------------------------------
0x400000
400fff
4ff123

8000000123
